{{SystemsNav|title=Classes}} '''Bard''' is a default base class with Arelith specific changes. __TOC__ == Introduction == Arelith Bards enjoy changes that benefit their spellcasting and requirements. Mechanical changes are included in the [[#Class Mechanics]] on this page and explained in the [[#Arelith Changes]] section. Base mechanics can be found [http://nwn.wikia.com/wiki/Bard on NWNWiki]. The [[#Roleplay Tips]] section provides suggestions for character development. == Class Mechanics == === Requirements === '''Alignment restrictions:''' '''''None''''' === Class Features === {{ClassPicture|title=Bard|image=Bard.png}} '''Hit die:''' d6 '''Proficiencies:''' armor (light, medium), shields, weapons (simple, whips) '''Skill points:''' '''''6''''' + int modifier (('''''6''''' + int modifier) * 4 at 1st level) '''Class Skills:''' appraise, '''''animal empathy''''', bluff, concentration, '''''climb''''', craft mastery, discipline, heal, hide, '''''intimidate''''', leadership, listen, lore, move silently, '''''parry''''', perform, '''''ride''''', '''''sail''''', '''''search''''', sleight of hand, spellcraft, '''''spot''''', taunt, tumble, use magic device '''Bonus Feats:''' Craft wand, Scribe scroll, Brew potion, Lingering song, Extra music, Curse song, Greater Spell Focus, Arcane Defense, Summon Familiar '''Unavailable feats:''' weapon specialization '''Primary saving throw(s):''' reflex, will '''Base attack bonus:''' +3/4 level '''Spellcasting:''' Arcane (spell failure from armor is a factor), charisma-based (a base charisma score of 10 + the spell's level is required to cast a spell, bonus spells are based on modified charisma, and the charisma modifier affects spell DCs), and spontaneous cast (no spell preparation required). This includes unique Bard Songs, unique Curse Songs, the ability to teach and learn songs with other bards, and the ability to find songs by exploring. * Has a persistent radius. * The radius is 15 meters (slightly bigger than previous Bard Song). * You must be within the radius to receive the bonuses. * If you leave the radius, the bonuses will fade after 3 rounds. * You will receive a message when entering and exiting the radius. * While on a ship, it's still ship-wide * Silence(normal saves and SR apply): :* The Song Source (Bard): ::* Entering the Silence aura removes the song from all affected by that Bards' song, including the Bard. ::* Exiting the Silence re-applies the song for free, as if newly cast. :* Song Effected individuals: ::* Entering the Silence drops the song effect from themself. ::* Exiting the Silence re-applies the song only if they are within a relevant radius around the original Bard they lost the song effect from. :'''''Note:''''' The use of Curse Song (only) will toggle Expertise and Improved Expertise off. ==== Learning Songs ==== * [[Bard]]s begin knowing songs based on their starting location, race, and other conditions. See [[Bard#Starting_Songs|Starting Songs]] on this page for full list. ** Humans, Half-Orcs, and Half-Elves are granted one random Bard Song and one random Curse Song upon reaching a combined [[Bard]] + [[Dirgesinger]] level of 5+. ** All bards gain a random Bard Song or Curse Song at Bard 10, 20, and 30. * The exploration songs can be found by walking around the right areas. These areas are typically (but not always) dungeons that take a little effort to get to. * Not all songs are discoverable. Some must be learned from other PCs. '''''Note:''''' Although a [[Bard]] may know/learn a song, they are unable to use the Song until they meet the [[Bard#Using_Songs|requirements]] for doing so are met. ====Teaching Songs==== * Anyone who can learn Bard Songs and Curse Songs can teach them. ** Use -song teach or -cursesong teach to teach songs to all nearby bards. Costs 1000 Adventure XP. Any song can be taught, whether racial or discovered in the world, '''except''' the Lich Lyrics. ==== Using Songs ==== * '''Once the [[Bard]] has a combined [[Bard]] + [[Dirgesinger]] level of 5+''', they can then adjust the default Song (applied in addition to the Baseline Song), selecting any Song they current know in place of the default. One replacement for default Bard Song and one replacement for default Curse Song is allowed. ** Use -song to review your available Song lists (Bard and Curse) ** Use the -song and -cursesong commands to swap between songs. ** It is recomemnded to use the [[Console_command#-toolbar|-toolbar command]] for songs, as it features the ability to autocast them directly without having to switch them manually. * '''Perform Requirements''': (Bard Level * 2) + 10 at level 25 ==== Song Duration ==== * Base (minimum) song duration is 10 rounds. ** Bards '''''without''''' Lasting Inspiration gain 1 additional round to their Song duration for every effective Song level they have above 10. * You can toggle the duration states (switch between maximum and minimum duration) of your songs by using: ** Bard Song: -songdur ** Curse Song: -songdur curse * The Lingering Song Feat (+5 rounds duration) is now applied before Lasting Inspiration (10x Duration): ** Song Duration with both feats becomes 150 rounds instead of 105 rounds (vanilla) * Examples: ** If you have 20 effective Song Levels (Ex: 10 Bard / 20 Palemaster) and do not have Lasting Inspiration, your Bard Song and Curse Song will last 20 rounds *** If you use the -songdur function this will reduce back to the minimum of 10 rounds ==== Song Cooldown ==== [[Bard]]s regain a bard song usage every 7.5 minutes subject to the following reductions: * Bards inherently will decrease Song cooldown as their song gains in effective level (cumulative to a 3 minute reduction at 28th level): :::At 5th effective song level: -15 seconds :::At 10th effective song level: -15 seconds :::At 15th effective song level: -15 seconds :::At 20th effective song level: -15 seconds :::At 25th effective song level: -15 seconds :::At 28th effective song level: -15 seconds * Taking Extra Music, Skill Focus: Perform, or Artist reduces this time by 3 minutes. (Only one reduction applies) *Curse Song recharges 1 minute faster. * Examples: ** A level 30 [[Bard]] without the above feat(s) will cooldown at: *** Bard Song: 6 minutes *** Curse Song: 5 minutes ** A level 25 [[Bard]] with one or more reduction feats will cooldown at: *** Bard Song: 3 Minutes and 15 seconds. *** Curse Song: 2 Minutes and 15 seconds. ** A level 10 [[Bard]] / level 20 [[Palemaster]], having an effective level 20 song, with one or more reduction feats will cooldown at: *** Bard Song: 3.5 minutes *** Curse Song: 2.5 minutes ==== General Song Customizations ==== * Bard Song and Curse Song no longer persists after a bard dies. * Curse Song now displays the Curse Song name to the victim. * Damage for Curse Songs is now rolled separately for each creature in the area of effect. * Bards now always replace their own song, even when a higher level bard has buffed them. * Epic Skill Focus: Perform adds an additional effect to each Bard Song and Curse Song. * Perform skill added by the Bard Song cannot be used to boost subsequent songs. * Party buff song effects are removed when using Selfish Solo. * All AC is Dodge AC. * Bard Song used on a ship will affect everyone on a ship deck even if they are outside of the traditional range of the song. * Bard Song effective level is reduced by 3 when wearing Heavy Armor and/or a Tower Shield. * Bard Song and Curse Song are now completely separate counters that are scaled differently than the single counter before. :: Song Charges across Bard and all the existing synergies are outlined in the [[#Bard_Synergies]] Table :: '''Note''': The minimum number of Bard Song and Curse Song charges is 3. ==== Custom Song Tables ==== Song work by using the Baseline song (see below) and applying the Bard Song and Curse Song on top. * Examples: ** Level 20 Bard 10 Earthkin Defender with 70 Perform skill singing Bard Song would receive 2 AB, 2 bludgeon damage, 2 universal saves, 3 AC, and 3 to all their skills from the baseline song from the level 20 bonuses. Then, if they had chosen -song 15 (Song of the Miner's Melody) they would also receive 4 AC vs Elementals, 7 Concentration, and 10/+4 Damage Resistance. The 20 Bard 10 Earthkin Defender gets the level 30 effects since the song has a special caveat that Earthkin Defender levels stack with Bard for that specific song. If the singer only had 40 Perform then the singer would only get the benefits from the level 20 version of the Miner's Melody song benefits. ** Level 26 Bard 4 Blackguard with 62 Perform signing Curse Song would affect their victims' -2 AB, -2 bludgeon damage, -2 universal saves, -4 AC, and -8 to all skills from the Baseline song. Then, if the singer had chosen -cursesong 5 (Conqueror's Canticle) then the victim would also be affected with 13d4 negative damage, -5 fear saves, and -8 Leadership. This would be a total of -12 to Leadership. ==== Specific Songs Bonuses ==== * Skills they provide are '''capped by the targets hard rank investments'''. * This is calculated as a % investment of your max possible hard ranks for any given level and your hard ranks. * Functionally, this means if a person is level 30, has 5 hard ranks in Animal Empathy, and a level 30 bard sings Ranger's Round (5 base + 7 song specific), the Ranger's Round would at best give 1 more (always rounded down) Animal Empathy, totaling a score of 6 for the listener from the level 30 Bard Song. * Mathematically this is as follows: Bonus To Skills = Song Skill Bonus * (Hard Skill Ranks / (PC Level + 3)) If Bonus To Skills > Hard Skill Ranks, instead use Hard Skill Ranks. ==== Noisy Songs ==== * If a song is noisy (it applies to others) then it will negate bonuses to listen and move silently for the Bard. * This means only Selfish Solo provides any Listen or Move Silently to the Bard. ==== Synergy Bonus ==== Some songs benefit from multiclassing and scale at a 1:1 conversion, the bonus has a maximum equal to the current song level(before the synergy is applied).
'''Disclaimer: It was previously thought the song scaled as long as there was a majority of bard levels which does not seem to be the case It is unconfirmed if the current behavior is intended or applies to all cases, always test on [[PGCC]] beforehand and be aware it might be changed/fixed in the future if it is deemed unintended.''' This means, for example, a bard 20/fighter 10 would sing a Draconic Dirge at effective lvl 30 and benefit fully from the baseline bardic rhythm and the specific song bonuses at 30, but all other songs at 20.
However, the Perform requirement must still be met.
